rationale: The app is a daily B2B utility for warehouse workers, couriers, and admins. It must feel fast, precise, and authoritative. Status colors (late, on-time, penalty) must pop against a high-contrast clean background. Archetype 4 emphasizes clarity and function over decoration, fitting for an enterprise operational tool.

typography.note: Use 'Outfit' for its geometric clarity and modern tech feel on headings. 'IBM Plex Sans' provides extreme legibility for numerical data like Rupiah (Rp) penalties, bonuses, and time formats (10:00 AM) which is crucial for workers.

layout_and_spacing.mobile_container: For the main app, use a max-w-md mx-auto container with h-screen, relative positioning, and overflow-hidden to simulate a mobile app experience on desktop browsers.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-4 or p-6 for screen padding. Gap-4 for standard vertical flow.
layout_and_spacing.navigation: Bottom Tab Navigation (fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md bg-white border-t border-slate-200 z-50) for mobile users. Tabs: Beranda (Home), Absensi (Attendance), Cuti (Leave), Laporan (Reports), Profil (Profile).
layout_and_spacing.admin_dashboard: For Admin Control panels (Rule Engine, User Management), use a desktop-friendly layout (w-full) or a slide-out drawer/separate route not constrained to mobile width, emphasizing data density using the 'Control Room' grid.
layout_and_spacing.surface_treatment: Use 'Neumorphism' (Tactile) strategy for the main Check-In/Out button (large, drop-shadow, interactive). Use 'Grid Borders' for Admin config tables (Rule Engine) to look technical.

components.buttons: Shadcn based. Main Check-In CTA should be massive and clear (Green for check-in, Red for check-out if active).
components.cards: Flat background, 1px border (border-slate-200), rounded-xl, no massive shadows. Keep it clean (Swiss style).
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs. Large touch targets for mobile (h-12).
components.drawers: Use Shadcn Drawer (bottom sheet) for complex mobile interactions like Leave Requests and filtering.
components.data_display: Use Shadcn Tables for Admin Rules Config and User Management. Use Recharts for daily/weekly/monthly attendance trends.

core_workflows.auth: Login screen defaults to Indonesian. Handle default admin (administrator/admin123) and force password change on first login.
core_workflows.home_check_in: Big live clock. GPS/Geofencing validation status (Valid/Invalid location). Display today's shift (10:00 AM - 08:00 PM) and quick stats (Lateness/Bonuses).
core_workflows.admin_control: Manage warehouses (GPS data), users (roles/locations), and dynamic rule engine (penalty fees, bonuses, progressive overtime rates, early departure limits).
core_workflows.leave_request: Form requires >= 2 hours before shift, cancellation up to H-1. Division-based visibility.
core_workflows.manual_attendance: Emergency flow for couriers requiring supervisor approval.

motion_and_accessibility.motion: Use active:scale-95 on touch targets. Micro-interactions on bottom tab selection.
motion_and_accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-btn').
motion_and_accessibility.language: Default Indonesian UI text (e.g., Masuk, Beranda, Absen, Simpan). English toggleable via settings.

file_type_instruction: Ensure code is generated in .js (React JS + Tailwind + Shadcn) as per environment rules.
